checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Revised poster, story and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must.why: Poster and story show it cleanly. The reel shows it at 1 s, 4 s and 7 s. By 9.5 s the date is pushed out of frame and cropped, so it isn't fully displayed.

must.item: Old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must.why: No 17 October in the revised images or in the sampled reel frames. The 17 October frames come from the earlier clip 03 and from the originals, not from the revised pack.

must.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof', 'Free entry' without alteration.
must.why: The images keep all four lines. In the reel, 'Free entry' is cut off at 7 s and gone later. At 7 s 'Rooftop Jazz' is cropped. At 9.5 s the title shows as 'ooftop Jaz' and 7 PM and Atlas Roof are gone.

must.item: Revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date.
must.why: The still images keep the design intact. In the reel, the flat vector silhouette turns into a photographic rooftop scene and the layout is zoomed and cropped away.

must.item: Final pack has two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must.why: There is a 9:16 story, a 4:5 poster and a 10 s vertical reel at about 9:16.

exact_text.read_as: Rooftop Jazz (cropped to 'ooftop Jaz' late in the reel)
24 October 2027 on the images and early reel; cropped at 9.5 s
Free entry on the images; cut off in the reel from 7 s

faults.what: The reel zooms in and morphs the flat burgundy silhouette into a photographic rooftop scene, so it no longer matches the poster design.

Late in the reel the text is cropped or pushed out of frame. 'Rooftop Jazz' becomes 'ooftop Jaz', the date is partly cut, and 'Free entry', '7 PM' and 'Atlas Roof' are missing, so the date and details aren't shown for the whole 10 s.
The border is lost in the reel as it zooms in.
The saxophone player's silhouette changes a little between frames.

summary: The revised poster and story are clean, with the correct 24 October 2027 and the design unchanged, but the reel zooms and morphs into a photo look and crops the text away in its second half, so it needs a redo.
